data.title: Tempest Therapeutics Announces New Private Warrant Financing
data.description:
The latest update is out from Tempest Therapeutics ( (TPST) ).

On September 11, 2026, Tempest Therapeutics entered into a securities purchase agreement with an institutional investor for a private placement of pre-funded warrants and Series C and D common stock warrants, raising approximately $2.5 million in gross proceeds. The transaction, which closed on September 15, 2026, provides additional working capital and general corporate funding, while potentially adding up to about $5 million more if the common warrants are exercised in cash.

The deal structure includes investor-friendly warrant terms, ownership caps to limit immediate dilution, and commitments by Tempest to seek shareholder approval for warrant share issuance and to register the underlying shares for resale with the SEC. Tempest also agreed to short-term restrictions on additional equity or variable-rate financings, signaling efforts to stabilize its capital structure, and engaged H.C.
